tools.name: mend_repair_json
tools.description: Use when JSON from an LLM, API, log, config or copy-paste fails to parse (JSON.parse error, "Unexpected token", "Expecting property name"), or the user pastes JSON with trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, comments, Python True/False/None, NaN, missing commas or brackets, a ```json fence,

tools.name: mend_check_json
tools.description: Use when you need to know whether text is strictly valid JSON, and if not, exactly where it breaks. Strict RFC 8259 check (the same accept/reject as JSON.parse). Returns line, column, the offending line with a caret and whether Mend can repair it. Use mend_repair_json to fix it. Up to 100,000 charac

tools.name: mend_outline_json
tools.description: Use when you are about to read a big JSON response, log or export into context, before loading it: returns a compact outline of the structure (keys, types, array lengths, one example per repeated shape) so you can plan a query without spending tokens on the whole document. Repairs the JSON first if

tools.name: mend_query_json
tools.description: Use when you need specific fields from a JSON document without reading all of it: $.users[0].name, $.items[*].id, $.a.b[-1], $.list[1:3], $..email (recursive). Returns each match with its exact path, type and value. Repairs the JSON first if needed, so broken input still works. Up to 100,000 charact

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mend_repair_json, mend_query_json · Private data: mend_repair_json, mend_outline_json, mend_query_json · Public sink: mend_query_json.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mend_repair_json, mend_query_json · Private data: mend_repair_json, mend_outline_json, mend_query_json · Public sink: mend_query_json

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
